clues: This market town is in England. It stands where the Severn and Avon rivers meet.
In winter, water spreads all around this town. It is the only town in England called semi coastal.
In 1471, a big fight in the Wars of the Roses took place here. It was one of the key fights of those wars.
Each year, the town holds a fair from long past times. Folks act out the old fight for the crowds.
Its great abbey was built in the twelfth century. The town grew up in the years that came after it.
